facts.fact: 2025 revenue ~$916K, +30% YoY, profitable and bootstrapped; raising $1.5M
Revenue mix: ~57% corporate events, ~22% brick-and-mortar, ~14% gifting/DTC, ~7% wholesale
3,200+ corporate events delivered, 82,000+ participants, clients incl. Google, Cisco, Meta, Salesforce, PwC
Flagship store at 411 S B St, San Mateo CA, open ~1 year, $200K year one
Founded 2014 by Renata Stoica, a Brazilian former nurse; brigadeiros are gluten-free, made in small batches
Valentine's Day spending expected at record $29.1B; candy is the most-planned gift (56% of celebrants)
84% of Americans enhance Valentine's with chocolate/candy; 92% hope to receive chocolate
US confectionery $42.5B in 2025, +5.3% dollars; 99.8% household penetration; avg buyer spends $352/yr
Edible gifts are 36% of corporate gifts; 81% of recipients find them most appreciated; 79% more likely to remember the giver

problem_candidates.problem: Revenue concentration: 57% of revenue is corporate events - a capacity-limited, relationship-driven channel - while consumer DTC gifting is only ~14% and wholesale ~7%
Corporate event kits reach 82,000+ participants but contain no consumer purchase path - the B2B audience never converts to DTC buyers
Seasonal gifting spike (Valentine's, holidays) is the biggest consumer occasion but the brand has no gifting-specific campaign engine
